content: No dedicated 'no-email OAuth-expiry banner' pattern found separately; the pattern is the same as broker-connection-health UI: a persistent in-app banner/badge tied to connection status, shown on next login, cleared automatically once re-auth succeeds. Given Schwab's 7-day hard expiry (confirmed via schwab-py docs and developer.schwab.com), a push/in-app banner on login plus a persistent 'needs reconnect' state on the affected account is sufficient without email — the user will log in at least weekly to use the journal.
